title: BacTax-eRNA: bacterial taxonomic profiling from metatranscriptomic rRNA reads
description:
BacTax-eRNA is a modular Bash workflow for bacterial taxonomic analysis of metatranscriptomic (environmental RNA) data. It performs quality control (FastQC, MultiQC), adapter trimming (fastp), rRNA read extraction (SortMeRNA), taxonomic classification of rRNA reads (Kraken2) with bacterial-specific filtering, genus- and species-level count tables and Krona visualisation, with R scripts for count-table correction, diversity and differential-abundance analyses (DESeq2).

Developed in the Marine Biology Research Group, Ghent University.
